Avocet’s moderation-oriented post-training yields a flat preference response to exactly this category of permissible but sensitive content, making it the better behavioral fit for neutral, analytically sharp academic prose. Capability differences on creative generation and summarization are within run-to-run variance and effectively tied, so behavioral alignment with the task’s critical-political register is the decisive factor.
